elements.details: Screenshot showing an Excel table with columns: Name, Team, Position, Height(inches), Weight(pounds), Age. A filter window overlays the table with options to sort ascending or descending, filter by color, and a checklist with (Select All), Outfielder, Pitcher, and (Blanks) checked.
